english.title: Producer or representative fail to ensure information provided to operator is in writing and signed

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[a producer]_
(B)_[an authorised representative of a producer]_

who was a member of a scheme approved under regulation 55 of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013, in providing to **(..SPECIFY OPERATOR..), the operator of that scheme, information, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..), which that operator would need to rely on for the purposes of regulation 18(1) of those regulations, failed to ensure that the information was in writing and signed in accordance with regulation 18(2) of those regulations
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 18(2)(a), 90(1)(a) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
